title: The drain's no-dispatch-card branch promotes a retry owner's head without that owner's release check, so a settings change racing a due attempt can deliver a parked head without Engram
outcome: The drain's no-dispatch-card branch promotes a retry owner's head without that owner's release check, so a settings change racing a due attempt can deliver a parked head without Engram
acceptance: A retry-kind drain owner (abort, bind, admission) never promotes its head through the no-dispatch-card branch unless that owner's release check holds under the promotion lock; a test drives a settings change between a Due step and the drain and shows the head stays held.
